title: PMA Round-1 nomination form v6 — data-driven schema + case prose
description: Every nomination is a rule-by-rule evaluation of the seat's PM-signed canon against the fields it was served, followed by a bounded case. The registrar verifies mechanically: (1) glossary_sha matches the reading card served; (2) every export_path is on the seat's v6 menu; (3) every value equals the packet value for that ticker/path (a wrong value is a misread, rejected on arrival); (4) every rule id exists in the seat's canon; (5) fields_cited is a subset of the menu. The prose is the seat's; the numbers are the house's.

glossary_sha.description: sha of the reading card the seat was served; mismatch = wrong card = reject

rule.description: canon recogniser or principle id, e.g. R1, C3

export_path.description: the served path from binding.yaml; null only when result is UNSERVED

test.description: the rule's own condition in the field's units and direction, e.g. '< -100' or 'ABOVE'

proxy_loss.description: required when result is PROXY_*: what the stand-in field does not capture

case.description: the argument, in the seat's own method: what the setup is, why now, what kills it. No seat names, no other voices, no numbers that are not in rule_checks.

falsifier.description: one observable that, if seen before the stop, means the thesis was wrong

fields_cited.description: subset of the seat's menu; registrar rejects any other path

declined.description: optional: names that came closest and the single rule that failed — the near-miss record

shortfall_reason.description: required when nominations is empty: which rule, on how many names, failed or was UNSERVED — counts, not adjectives
